lines.text: [warm, gentle storyteller for small children] म्याऊँ! म्याऊँ!
[cheerful, excited little child] बताओ, कौन?
[sweet, soft, giggly little girl] शेर!
[cheerful, excited little child] ना-ना! मूँछें देखो…
[cheerful, excited little child] बिल्ली!
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] Cat! Cat!
[happy children cheering together] बिल्ली — Cat!
[happy children cheering together] बिल्ली — Cat!
[warm, gentle storyteller for small children] मूँ… मूँ!
[sweet, soft, giggly little girl] हाथी!
[cheerful, excited little child] हाथी तो मैं हूँ!
[cheerful, excited little child] सींग देखो…
[cheerful, excited little child] गाय!
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] Cow! Cow!
[happy children cheering together] गाय — Cow!
[happy children cheering together] गाय — Cow!
[warm, gentle storyteller for small children] क्वैक! क्वैक!
[sweet, soft, giggly little girl] मेरी बारी?
[cheerful, excited little child] हाँ, बनी! देखो…
[sweet, soft, giggly little girl] बत्तख!
[cheerful, excited little child] हाँ! बत्तख! शाबाश, बनी!
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] Duck! Duck!
[happy children cheering together] बत्तख — Duck!
[happy children cheering together] बत्तख — Duck!
[happy children cheering together] Cat, cow, duck!
[happy children cheering together] Cat, cow, duck!
[cheerful, excited little child] कल फिर मिलेंगे!
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] Tomorrow! Tomorrow!
